show.description: Rented a Rich Boyfriend is a dramatic romance filled with betrayal, secrets, and unexpected twists. Aditya, a simple middle-class man, is humiliated and abandoned by his fiancée Nandita when she chooses money and power over love. But fate ties him to Isha Raheja, a fierce billionaire heiress, sparking a fake marriage deal that slowly unravels shocking truths, hidden identities, and a love story no one saw coming.
